nodes.summary: Let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings and let $t$ and $s$ assign a natural number to every Boolean string. Then $L$ is decidable within time $t$ and space $s$ in CSLib's sense, with the identity encoding of inputs, if and only if there are a number $k$, a finite type of states and a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes over the Boolean alphabet that decides $L$ and, on every input $w$, runs in time…
nodes.title: Decidability within time and space bounds, unfolded

nodes.summary: A deterministic multi-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet decides a language $L$ of Boolean strings when, on every input $w$, it eventually halts with output the one-bit string $[\mathrm{true}]$ if $w \in L$ and $[\mathrm{false}]$ if $w \notin L$.
nodes.title: A multi-tape machine deciding a language

nodes.summary: Let $s_1, s_2 : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $a, b \in \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $s_1(n) \le a \, s_2(n) + b$ for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Then $\mathrm{DSPACE}(s_1) \subseteq \mathrm{DSPACE}(s_2)$.

nodes.summary: Let $t_1, t_2 : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $a, b \in \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $t_1(n) \le a \, t_2(n) + b$ for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Then $\mathrm{DTIME}(t_1) \subseteq \mathrm{DTIME}(t_2)$.

nodes.summary: $\mathrm{P}$ is the set of languages of Boolean strings that lie in $\mathrm{DTIME}(n \mapsto n^d)$ for some $d \in \mathbb{N}$.

nodes.summary: $\mathrm{PSPACE}$ is the set of languages of Boolean strings that lie in $\mathrm{DSPACE}(n \mapsto n^d)$ for some $d \in \mathbb{N}$.
nodes.title: Polynomial space on multi-tape machines

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $w$ be an input word and let $T \in \mathbb{N}$. If $M$ runs in time $T$ on $w$, that is, every computation path of $M$ on $w$ with at least $T$ steps ends in a halted configuration, then $M$ runs in space $k(T + 1)$ on $w$: every computation path of $M$ on $w$ visits at most $k(T + 1)$ work-tape cells, counting the cells visited on each work tape…
nodes.title: Time bounds space on one input

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and let $t : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$. If $M$ is time bounded by $t$, then $M$ is space bounded by the function $n \mapsto k(t(n) + 1)$.
nodes.title: Uniform time bounds give uniform space bounds

nodes.summary: A deterministic Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes is space bounded by $s : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ when, for every input word $w$, every computation path of $M$ on $w$ visits at most $s(|w|)$ work-tape cells, counting the cells visited on each work tape and summing over the tapes, where $|w|$ is the length of $w$.
nodes.title: Space-bounded multi-tape machine

nodes.summary: A deterministic Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes is time bounded by $t : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ when, for every input word $w$, every computation path of $M$ on $w$ with at least $t(|w|)$ steps ends in a halted configuration, where $|w|$ is the length of $w$.
